g.text: 1 Browser → CloudFront: HTTPS :443. 2 CloudFront → nginx: HTTP :80 → :8080 + origin auth header.
3 nginx → Node: HTTP :8787 /api + SSE. 4 Browser → Cognito: HTTPS :443, authorization code + PKCE.
5 Node → Cognito: HTTPS :443 token exchange. 6 Node → PostgreSQL: TLS :5432.
7 Browser → S3: HTTPS :443 presigned PUT. 8 Node → S3: HTTPS :443 with IAM user credentials.
9 Node → push service: HTTPS :443 / VAPID. 10 Push service → PWA: push event.
11 Actions → STS: OIDC / HTTPS :443, 1 h dev role. 12 Actions → host: SCP / SSH :22, runner /32.
AWS ap-southeast-1. OIDC: dev branch + environment. Node owns the cycle, media and reminder loops.
